_readme: The cards Tim is actively hunting. Drives /wanted.html and the Most Wanted
Add an entry by naming the set and the card. `number` is what disambiguates:
Mega Darkrai ex exists three times in Pitch Black (Ultra Rare #101, Special
Illustration Rare #116, Mega Hyper Rare #120) and only the number says which
one you mean. Run scripts/sync-wanted.mjs to attach the image, the TCGplayer
link and the raw market price.
PRICES. `raw` is filled in automatically from the Pokemon TCG API when that
card has TCGplayer data. The four newest sets do not yet, so raw sits empty
for them and the site simply omits it rather than printing a zero.
`psa10` is ALWAYS manual. No free API carries graded prices, so nothing can
fetch it. Put in a number you have actually seen (PSA price guide, or eBay
sold listings), set `psa10AsOf` to the date you checked, and `psa10Source`
to where it came from. Leave it null and the site shows nothing rather than
`got` flips a card from hunting to caught, which is worth doing on camera.
